note: Adds Claude Sonnet 5 (launched Jun 30, 2026 — the new DEFAULT model in Claude Code v2.1.197 and on Free/Pro). Inherits the 2026-06-15 models/rates/pools unchanged. Sonnet 5 ships at the introductory $2/$10 rate through Aug 31, 2026, then steps up to $3/$15 on Sep 1 — encoded as a `scheduled` rate array (the newest scheduled entry whose effective_date <= today wins; before any scheduled date, the base input/output rate applies). This is how a FUTURE-DATED rate change is represented without prematurely activating it (the pricing loader picks the newest FILENAME, so a separate future-dated file would activate immediately — the schedule avoids that). Fable-5 rates carried forward unchanged ($10/$50, cache-read $1). Fable re-arm folded into this same coordinated drop (Jul 1): fable_cliff_date moved 2026-06-23 -> 2026-07-07 for the new mechanic (included up to 50% of the weekly limit through ~July 12, extended from July 7 after backlash — MON-FABLE-EXT-078; hedge it, the date has already moved once and may move again), then usage credits at $10/$50 (an allowance cap, not free). ⚠ VERIFY LIVE rates before any published number (Sonnet 5 $2/$10 intro -> $3/$15 confirmed via anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5 + platform.claude.com/docs/pricing, Jul 1 2026).
